title: After the Japanese Derby: Victory Hashtag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser wins the Japanese Derby! Tokyo Racecourse is in shock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon declares Rice Shower as her biggest threat at the Kikuka Sho and challenges her publicly, causing the crowd to go wild!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They clap just as much for the two of them as they do for Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some spectators find that disrespectful to Machitan, but she doesn't seem to mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She posts on social media that she plans on doing her best at the Kikuka Sho. Thanks to her optimism, she gains a few more new fans.
